title: [Bugfix][Frontend] Count prompts over max_model_len in Anthropic count_tokens
root_cause: count_tokens renders through render_chat_request with ChatCompletionRequest.build_tok_params (max_total_tokens=max_model_len): tokenization stops at max_model_len + 1 tokens and _token_len_check raises a 400, while /tokenize renders with max_total_tokens=None
fix: Optional tok_params on render_chat_request / OnlineRenderer.render_chat / OnlineRenderer.preprocess_chat; count_tokens passes the chat request's params with max_total_tokens=None. Generation keeps the check; Harmony chat rendering never applied tok params
environment: Ubuntu 24.04 / WSL2, Python 3.12, CPU only (Intel i5-11300H), --enforce-eager; Python sources from the branch, compiled CPU extensions from nightly CPU wheel 0.33.0rc1.dev711+gdd4e40142 (31 commits before the base, no CPU kernel or custom-op changes in between)
